name: advantages are grouped, finite, and detached
test:
import torch
rewards = torch.tensor([1., 3., 10., 14.], requires_grad=True)
advantages = group_relative_advantages(rewards, 2)
assert not advantages.requires_grad
assert torch.allclose(advantages[:2].mean(), torch.tensor(0.), atol=1e-6)
assert torch.allclose(advantages[2:].mean(), torch.tensor(0.), atol=1e-6)
assert torch.equal(group_relative_advantages(torch.tensor([7., 7.]), 2), torch.zeros(2))
expected = torch.tensor([-1., 1., -1., 1.])
assert torch.allclose(advantages, expected, atol=2e-6)
assert torch.allclose(group_relative_advantages(torch.tensor([1., 3.]), 2, eps=1.), torch.tensor([-.5, .5]))
assert torch.equal(group_relative_advantages(torch.tensor([1., 3.]), 1), torch.zeros(2))

name: response log probabilities use causal alignment and masks
test:
import torch
logits = torch.tensor([[[0., 0., 0.], [0., 2., 0.], [0., 0., 3.]]])
sequences = torch.tensor([[0, 1, 2]])
mask = torch.tensor([[False, True, False]])
values = gather_response_logprobs(logits, sequences, mask)
expected = torch.log_softmax(logits[:, 0], dim=-1)[0, 1]
assert values.shape == (1, 2)
assert values[0, 1].item() == 0.0
assert torch.allclose(values[0, 0], expected)

name: only selected predictable tokens contribute log-probability gradients
test:
import torch
logits = torch.tensor([[[0., 1., -1.], [2., 0., -1.], [-1., 1., 0.], [1., 0., 2.]]], requires_grad=True)
sequences = torch.tensor([[2, 1, 0, 2]])
mask = torch.tensor([[False, True, False, True]])
values = gather_response_logprobs(logits, sequences, mask)
expected = torch.zeros((1, 3))
expected[0, 0] = torch.log_softmax(logits[0, 0], dim=-1)[1]
expected[0, 2] = torch.log_softmax(logits[0, 2], dim=-1)[2]
assert values.shape == (1, 3) and torch.allclose(values, expected)
values.sum().backward()
expected_grad = torch.zeros_like(logits)
expected_grad[0, 0] = -torch.softmax(logits.detach()[0, 0], dim=-1)
expected_grad[0, 0, 1] += 1
expected_grad[0, 2] = -torch.softmax(logits.detach()[0, 2], dim=-1)
expected_grad[0, 2, 2] += 1
assert torch.allclose(logits.grad, expected_grad)

name: compact log probabilities preserve batch shape and empty-mask gradients
test:
import torch
for dtype in (torch.float32, torch.float64):
 for length in (2, 4):
  p = torch.arange(2 * length * 3, dtype=dtype).reshape(2, length, 3).requires_grad_()
  seq = torch.tensor([[0, 2, 1, 0], [1, 0, 2, 1]])[:, :length]
  mask = torch.ones(2, length, dtype=torch.bool)
  before = [x.detach().clone() for x in (p, seq, mask)]
  actual = gather_response_logprobs(p, seq, mask)
  expected = torch.stack([torch.stack([torch.log_softmax(p[n, t], -1)[seq[n, t+1]] for t in range(length-1)]) for n in range(2)])
  assert actual.shape == (2, length-1)
  assert actual.dtype == dtype and actual.device == p.device
  assert torch.allclose(actual, expected)
  assert all(torch.equal(x.detach(), old) for x, old in zip((p, seq, mask), before))
  for position_zero in (False, True):
   empty = torch.zeros_like(mask)
   empty[:, 0] = position_zero
   out = gather_response_logprobs(p, seq, empty)
   assert out.shape == (2, length-1) and out.requires_grad
   assert torch.equal(out, torch.zeros_like(out))
   grad = torch.autograd.grad(out.sum(), p)[0]
   assert torch.equal(grad, torch.zeros_like(p))

name: aligned KL uses reference-to-policy direction and masked token mean
test:
import torch
p = torch.tensor([[[.8, .2], [.5, .5], [.3, .7]], [[.9, .1], [.2, .8], [.6, .4]]], dtype=torch.float64).log().requires_grad_()
r = torch.tensor([[[.4, .6], [.1, .9], [.6, .4]], [[.2, .8], [.7, .3], [.3, .7]]], dtype=torch.float64).log().requires_grad_()
mask = torch.tensor([[True, False, True], [False, True, True]])
expected = (r.detach().exp() * (r.detach() - p)).sum(-1)[mask].mean()
actual = masked_kl(p, r, mask)
assert actual.ndim == 0 and torch.allclose(actual, expected, atol=1e-12)
actual.backward()
expected_grad = (p.detach().exp() - r.detach().exp()) * mask[..., None] / 4
assert torch.allclose(p.grad, expected_grad, atol=1e-12) and r.grad is None

name: combined loss exact causal KL and unequal response lengths
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(247)
p = torch.randn(4, 4, 3, dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
r = torch.randn_like(p, requires_grad=True)
rewards = torch.tensor([1., 3., 10., 14.], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
seq = torch.tensor([[0,1,2,0], [1,2,0,1], [2,0,1,2], [0,2,1,0]])
mask = torch.tensor([[True, True, False, False], [False, True, True, True], [False, False, True, False], [True, False, False, False]])
copies = [x.detach().clone() for x in (p, r, rewards, seq, mask)]
a = torch.tensor([-1/1.000001, 1/1.000001, -2/2.000001, 2/2.000001], dtype=p.dtype)
logp = torch.log_softmax(p[:, :-1], -1)
logr = torch.log_softmax(r.detach()[:, :-1], -1)
chosen = logp.gather(-1, seq[:, 1:, None]).squeeze(-1)
policy_term = -(a * (chosen * mask[:, 1:]).sum(-1)).mean()
kl = (logr.exp() * (logr - logp)).sum(-1)[mask[:, 1:]].mean()
expected = policy_term + .7 * kl
actual = grpo_loss(p, r, seq, mask, rewards, 2, beta=.7)
assert actual.ndim == 0 and torch.allclose(actual, expected, atol=1e-12)
expected_grad = torch.autograd.grad(expected, p, retain_graph=True)[0]
actual.backward()
assert torch.allclose(p.grad, expected_grad, atol=1e-12) and p.grad.abs().sum() > 0
assert r.grad is None and rewards.grad is None
assert all(torch.equal(x.detach(), before) for x, before in zip((p,r,rewards,seq,mask), copies))

name: empty masks preserve differentiable zero and ignore position zero
test:
import torch
for combined in (False, True):
 p = torch.randn(2, 3, 4, requires_grad=True)
 r = torch.randn_like(p, requires_grad=True)
 rewards = torch.tensor([1., 2.], requires_grad=True)
 mask = torch.zeros(2, 3, dtype=torch.bool)
 if combined:
  mask[:, 0] = True
  loss = grpo_loss(p, r, torch.zeros(2, 3, dtype=torch.long), mask, rewards, 2)
 else:
  loss = masked_kl(p, r, mask)
 assert loss.ndim == 0 and loss.item() == 0 and loss.requires_grad
 loss.backward()
 assert torch.equal(p.grad, torch.zeros_like(p))
 assert r.grad is None and rewards.grad is None
